## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed sector signals (Energy and Tech showing pockets of strength while Industrials/Materials/Utilities lag). Leadership concentrated: Concentrated (3/5 Technology) and multiple large-cap divergences temper conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +10.34%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.27% | 1M: +10.99%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows pockets of leadership: CSCO (1W: +20.42% | 1M: +37.83%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +47.48%) ABOVE TREND. Financials show selective strength: CME (1W: +7.98% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Materials weak: CRH (1W: -7.82% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -8.97% | 1M: -5.71%) BELOW TREND. Utilities under pressure: VST (1W: -10.06% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -12.44% | 1M: -11.41%) BELOW TREND. Industrials faltering: BA (1W: -7.39% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -5.73%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CSCO (1W: +20.42% | 1M: +37.83%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +47.48%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +13.04% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND; SYK (1W: +10.84% | 1M: -8.77%) RECOVERY; F (1W: +9.50% | 1M: +2.52%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: BA (1W: -7.39% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND; CRH (1W: -7.82% | 1M: -11.35%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -7.87% | 1M: +2.34%) CORRECTION; AMD (1W: -8.24% | 1M: +51.22%) CORRECTION; ETN (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -5.73%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Industrials/Materials with trend-exhaustion in some large-cap semiconductors.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: CSCO (1W: +20.42% | 1M: +37.83%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +47.48%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +13.04% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (multiple large caps with 1W ≠ 1M including AMD, INTC, QCOM, TSLA) — tactical risk, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is mixed but constructive at the index level: AAPL (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +10.32%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +0.18%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +10.23%) ABOVE TREND while AMD (1W: -8.24% | 1M: +51.22%) CORRECTION and QCOM (1W: -14.27% | 1M: +49.52%) CORRECTION show short-term exhaustion. Sector performance is mixed and needs follow-through to confirm breadth.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are selective: CME (1W: +7.98% | 1M: +6.07%) ABOVE TREND and V (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND provide leadership while JPM (1W: +0.24% | 1M: -3.08%) RECOVERY signals caution. Overall Financials are holding modest upside but lack uniform strength.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare shows defensive and mixed signals: UNH (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +20.48%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND contrast with JNJ (1W: +3.38% | 1M: -2.25%) RECOVERY and headline-driven pressure. Monitor biotech/pharma for news-driven volatility.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Energy and resilient Tech leaders (XOM, CSCO, PANW) while reducing exposure to names showing short-term exhaustion (AMD, QCOM, INTC, TSLA). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — stay selective and monitor large-cap divergences and news flow.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CSCO (1W: +20.42% | 1M: +37.83%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +47.48%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +10.34%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BA (1W: -7.39% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -10.06% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -16.43% | 1M: +57.91%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +11.80%) showing strong momentum; Technology (1W: +0.23% | 1M: +11.74%) for leadership concentration. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -2.76%), Utilities (1W: -2.86% | 1M: -4.40%) remain vulnerable.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +10.23%) ABOVE TREND for renewed 1W momentum as confirmation of tech breadth; AAPL (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +10.32%) ABOVE TREND to hold recent gains; TSLA (1W: -7.87% | 1M: +2.34%) CORRECTION — a failure to stabilize would broaden cyclicals’ weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
AAPL (+55): The Spill headline; AAPL (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +10.32%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment largely confirming price action. NOW (+55): BofA buy; NOW (1W: +13.04% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. F (+55): Ford growth strategy; F (1W: +9.50% | 1M: +2.52%) ABOVE TREND — confirming pickup. VST (+55): Analyst upgrades; VST (1W: -10.06% | 1M: -16.34%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from recent price weakness (watch for revision impact).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
HD (-50): Sluggish demand note; HD (1W: -3.72% | 1M: -14.19%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. JNJ (-50): Legal headwinds; JNJ (1W: +3.38% | 1M: -2.25%) RECOVERY — sentiment diverges from short-term bounce, monitor. LLY (-45): competitive pill risk; LLY (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment divergent, watch headlines for downside risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. CSCO (1W: +20.42% | 1M: +37.83%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.86% | 1M: +47.48%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +10.34%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergences (several semis and cyclicals in CORRECTION) and headline-driven sentiment mismatches (VST/LLY/JNJ) that could trigger wider rotation.
